items.q: How long is the response time for my question?
items.a: We are committed to responding to all questions within 1x24 business hours. For urgent questions, you can contact us directly by phone at the nearest office during operating hours.
No, the initial consultation is completely free with no commitment. Our team will help understand your needs and recommend the most suitable solution before you make a decision.

items.q: Do I need to come to the office for a consultation?
items.a: No need. We provide online consultation via video call for your convenience. However, if you'd like to visit our office in any city, please make an appointment in advance.

items.q: Does AuthenticGuards serve clients outside Indonesia?
items.a: Yes, we serve clients across Asia Pacific including Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam. Our team can communicate in Indonesian and English.
